'''Jood Kabbas''' was a renowned [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Artist/Legends|sculptor]] whose works were available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil" /> by [[980 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', which mentions Jood Kabbas is dated to [[980 BBY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> By this [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] had acquired several of Kabbas' sculptures, which he displayed in his [[Set Harth's mansion|mansion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jood Kabbas was mentioned in ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', a [[2009]] novel by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil" />
